source.why_this_clip: A sailing barge comes toward the camera and fills the frame; continuous until it leaves frame at 11.5 s.
source.sampled_continuity: The 16-frame retained sheet is one continuous approach; the source title and later cut are outside3–9s.

same native strokes reflected through held water gaps; approximation

camera.method: Manually observed far-vessel screen drift, source-pose coordinates480×360. Does not disentangle moving distant ships from camera.

mask_fit.method: Filled native sail and hull compared against nearest12fps SAMsample at145renderedframes; excludes drawn dinghy/reflection/background.
mask_fit.target_caveat: Main sail and hull broadly selected in sampled frames1,24,48; sample72 omits left hull. Model estimates are separate from measured filled-rig intersection-over-union.

assembly_summary: One real four-stroke sailboat approaches under source-keyed sail, mast and hull anchors. A single distant-vessel plate follows measured screen drift; trailing dinghy is drawn by agent. No invented sail flutter.
review_note: Independent pose, doodle identity and normal-speed motion review pending.
